title: growth-brain tick still runs growth:sync_cadence in the foreground under a fixed timeout (Hermes cron config, outside the repo)
evidence: Remaining half of growth-tick-kills-its-own-render (closed 2026-09-19): the repo side is fixed -- ReconcileStaleRuns bounds abandoned sync runs and Growth::RenderSalvage now recovers the renders themselves -- but the producer is still SIGKILLed by the tick's foreground budget (a ~45 min 5-render shortfall inside a 180s tool budget). tc-growth-harness-brain lives in ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json, which is outside this repo, so it is filed rather than edited. Cheapest fix: run growth:sync_cadence detached (direct >> log 2>&1 &) and let the next tick's render_need top up what is missing -- sync_cadence counts existing posts, so a partial run is safe to resume; or split into per-slot batches; or raise the tick's tool timeout above the measured ~45 min worst case. Needs Tim's ok (cron config + spend behaviour).

2026-09-20 18:3xZ ops-triage: option (b) -- an in-repo self-imposed deadline in the rake task -- is now REFUTED with numbers, not just deferred to Tim. The tick's foreground tool budget is Hermes's default 180s (the job record in cron/jobs.json carries no tool-timeout override), while one render costs ~9 min (the measured 45-min 5-render shortfall). A deadline that exits cleanly between renders can therefore never fire usefully: with a 180s ceiling the task either starts render #1 and is SIGKILLed mid-render exactly as today, or refuses to start any render and tops up nothing. The same arithmetic kills option (c) per-slot batches UNLESS each tick launches its render detached -- and a detached producer collides with the tick's own end-of-tick ComfyUI shutdown + claim release (option a). So the remaining fix is outside this repo either way: (a) detach the producer and defer the release to a follow-up tick, or (c) one detached render per tick, or raise the tick's tool timeout above the measured worst case.
